skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of corporate finance, principles of corporate financial management, and financial reporting systems.
Analyze financial statements and understand the impact of various taxes on businesses.
Understand and apply valuation methods for bonds and stocks.
Understand different methods of raising capital, including debt and equity financing.
Understand the concept of time value of money and its applications.
Apply knowledge to solve practical financial problems and propose solutions.
Work effectively in groups and individually, demonstrating social responsibility and professional ethics.
Analyze and synthesize information to make informed financial decisions.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral forms.
Understand and apply principles of financial management in business contexts.
